== Name

cell-styles - styled table paragraphs

== Synopsis

[cols="1a",options="header,footer"]
|===
|.Header title
[example#header-text]
Header text.

|.Body *title*
[example#body-example.cell-role]
Body text.

|.Footer title
[example#footer-example]
Footer text.
|===

[cols="1a"]
|===
|.Regular title
[#regular-target.regular-role]
Regular *bold* text.

|[#untitled-target.untitled-role]
Untitled paragraph.

|.Quote title
[quote,Writer,Book]
Quoted text.

|.Verse title
[verse,Poet,Poem]
Verse one.
Verse two.

|.Literal title
[literal]
<literal> *raw* text.

|.Listing title
[listing]
<listing> *raw* text.

|.Source title
[source,rust]
fn main() {}

|.Details title
[example%collapsible%open]
Details text.

|[example%collapsible]
Untitled details.

|.Abstract title
[abstract]
Abstract text.

|Plain paragraph one.

Plain paragraph two.

* Attached list.

|NOTE: Attached admonition.

d|.Normal text
[example]
NOTE: Normal cell text.

l|.Literal cell text
[example]
*Unprocessed literal cell text.*
|===

[cols="1"]
|===
a|.Explicit AsciiDoc title
[example]
Explicit AsciiDoc text.
|===

[cols="1a"]
|===
|
:cell-only: local

Single nested paragraph.

|{cell-only}

|[example]

|===

.Outer title
[example]
Outer example.

Outside <<regular-target>>, <<untitled-target>>, <<body-example>>, and <<footer-example>>.
